name: Three-step progress
what: A long progress bar seen through a moving camera with three steps along it: the camera eases in, holds while the fill grows past step 2 (its letters tumble in one by one), pans fast to the end, the fill finishes and step 3 tumbles in.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f30 the camera eases right 0.15 W (expo out); the fill grows steadily to f128 while the camera pushes in slowly (8 %, sine); f40 step 2's letters tumble in (3 f apart, 9 f each, expo out); f126-f164 the camera pans 0.55 W (S-curve) and the fill finishes by f170 (with the pan); f176-f216 the camera lifts, tilts 1.5 deg and settles while step 3 tumbles in (f192); a hold to f254

tracks.name: fill
tracks.what: the fill grows from 0.55 W to 0.97 W

tracks.name: step 2
tracks.what: its letters tumble in one by one

tracks.name: camera pan
tracks.what: the camera pans 0.55 W to the end of the bar

tracks.name: camera lift
tracks.what: lifts 6 % and tilts -1.5 deg, then settles

tracks.name: fill end
tracks.what: the fill reaches the end of the bar

tracks.name: step 3
tracks.what: its letters tumble in one by one
